item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-25
item.description:
It's been an exciting week in our open-source research community, with notable updates to two key projects. The `scienceverse/metacheck` project saw the addition of a reproducibility check feature, contributed by Lakens, which will enhance the tool's ability to verify research findings. Meanwhile, the `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` project released version 0.4.1, with a site build update courtesy of Anka, and a tweak to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js` by Alex O. Holcombe. These updates demonstrate the connections between our projects, with a focus on reproducibility and user experience. As our community continues to grow and collaborate, we celebrate the progress made and look forward to seeing how these updates will improve research workflows. With these latest developments, we're one step closer to advancing open-source research and promoting transparency in scientific inquiry.

5 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
